description.zh:
描述信息。

- 长度为2~256个英文或中文字符。
- 不能以 http:// 或 https:// 开头。
description.en:
Description.

- Must be 2 to 256 characters in length and can contain English or Chinese characters.

- Cannot start with http\:// or https\://.

description.zh:
交换机名称。

- 长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。
- 必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以 http:// 或 https:// 开头。
description.en:
vSwitch name.

- Must be 2 to 128 characters long. Can contain letters, digits, Chinese characters, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

- Must start with a letter or a Chinese character. Cannot start with http\:// or https\://.

descriptions.zh:
- API调用频率：100次/秒。
- 单用户调用频率：5次/秒。
descriptions.en:
- API call frequency: 100 calls per second.

- Per-user call frequency: 5 calls per second.
